charts.title: A diversified low-carbon energy architecture
constraints: Architecture is a recommended design, not an optimized build mix.
Keep demand, supply, grid, and delivery requirements visible.

charts.title: Published energy scenario families stay separate
constraints: AEO, NREL, and NGFS are source scenarios with different geographies and model boundaries.
Do not splice them into one national forecast.

charts.title: Portfolio requirements span six delivery systems
constraints: Scores are planning requirements, not performance results.

charts.title: Stress-test the architecture before claiming robustness
constraints: Cells state response logic and evidence gates, not reliability probabilities.
No stress case proves resource adequacy.

charts.title: Delivery phases advance only through evidence gates
constraints: Dates are sequencing horizons, not project completion forecasts.
A phase cannot clear while its named evidence gate is open.

charts.title: Versioned integrated energy model contract
constraints: No model output is authorized until inputs, equations, outputs, and validation tests are versioned.
Do not claim least cost, reliability, bills, or a final 2050 mix.
